precision: Forests preserve double preprocessing constants, raw inputs, split thresholds and leaf accumulation, with float32 transformed tree inputs and output; other models use float32. Unrolled code is not the historical 16-byte/node payload representation.
scope: Host-prepared causal features; imputation/scaling/inference onboard. Timing includes dispatch, conversion, optimizer barrier and volatile sink. No sensor, feature-generation, RF or energy measurement. Timings are per-call means of 64-call batches on each held-out input, not single-call samples.
